LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Classes: adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Classes: adjectives. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: When is it necessary to describe a noun?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify gradable and non-gradable adjectives from a text
2. use gradable and the non- gradable adjectives in sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify gradable and non-gradable adjectives from a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify gradable and non-gradable adjectives from a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use gradable and the non- gradable adjectives in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can use gradable and the non- gradable adjectives in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Classes: adjectives using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Classes: adjectives in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Classes: adjectives to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Classes: adjectives.
4. Show that you can: identify gradable and non-gradable adjectives from a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Classes: adjectives using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Classes: adjectives important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences using gradable and non-gradable adjectives, with peers,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify gradable and non-gradable adjectives from a text
2. use gradable and the non- gradable adjectives in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
